evals.prompt: Acabei de quebrar um módulo grande em vários arquivos dentro de services/. Cria um mapa de navegação dessa pasta pra eu ver o que está onde, com as linhas de cada função.
evals.expected_output: Runs navindex.py on the services/ folder (folder mode, auto-detected), producing services/__navi__.md that lists each file with its symbol outline and exact line numbers.
files: fixture repo with services/ containing several .py files

evals.prompt: Adicionei umas funções no topo de api.py e o índice de linhas lá no cabeçalho ficou todo errado agora. Conserta o NAV INDEX desse arquivo.
evals.expected_output: Runs navindex.py on api.py (file mode), stripping the stale header and rebuilding it so each Lnn points at the real current line of that symbol. Idempotent.
files: fixture api.py with an outdated NAV INDEX header

evals.prompt: Onde está a lógica de rate-limiting nesse repo? Não conheço o layout do projeto ainda.
evals.expected_output: Reads the folder's __navi__.md FIRST to locate the rate-limit symbol/file (and its line) instead of blindly grepping, then opens exactly that file/line.
files: fixture repo with an existing __navi__.md that indexes a file containing rate-limit logic

evals.prompt: Quero que os cabeçalhos NAV INDEX nunca mais fiquem desatualizados nesse repo, sem eu ter que lembrar de rodar nada.
evals.expected_output: Runs navindex.py --install-hook, which writes .git/hooks/pre-commit; explains that staged source files now get their headers refreshed (--auto) and re-staged on every commit, and that maps still need a folder run after structural changes.

evals.prompt: Roda o navindex duas vezes seguidas no mesmo arquivo e me prova que ele não duplica o cabeçalho nem muda os line endings.
evals.expected_output: Runs file mode twice; shows the second run produces a byte-identical file (single header, stripped and rebuilt) and that an LF file stays LF / CRLF stays CRLF.
files: fixture LF .py file and CRLF .py file

evals.prompt: Esse arquivo TypeScript tem uma classe grande com vários métodos — o índice deveria me mostrar cada método com a linha, não só o nome da classe.
evals.expected_output: Header/map lists the class as `class Name` plus each method and arrow-function field as `.method` with its exact line; statements inside method bodies do not appear as symbols.
files: fixture .ts file with an exported class containing methods, arrow fields, and nested calls like fetch().then()

evals.prompt: Renomeei services/ para core/ e apaguei metade dos arquivos. Atualiza os índices e não deixa lixo pra trás.
evals.expected_output: Re-runs folder mode from the repo root; the stale services/__navi__.md is auto-deleted (generated-map marker check), core/ gets a fresh map, and dead cache entries for removed files are pruned.
files: fixture repo where services/ was renamed to core/ leaving an old generated __navi__.md behind
